intro.text: Guiding teachings of the Idrian faith. To set an example of living by them, Idris's rich and noble families each give one member to the monasteries.
The five guiding teachings of Austrism, the main faith of Idris, held to have been spoken by Vo as a message from Austre.

description.text: The Visions ask believers to be patient, humble, self-sacrificing, selfless and understanding, and warn against showiness, pride, selfishness and setting oneself above others.

items.text: As Hoid told it, Vo, the first Returned, was born on a ship heading for the coast, proclaimed the five Visions, and died a week afterwards.
Fafen chose to become a monk while young and as an adult could recite several of the Visions from memory, while her sister Siri struggled even to list all five.
Vivenna came to see that many followers of Austrism had carried the Visions' call to humility too far, leading them to wrongly condemn Awakening.
